newsitem.title: UK: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: DIARY - Today in Westminster - Nov 26.

text.p: All eyes will be on Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke when he presents his crucial pre-election budget to the House of Commons at 1530 gmt on Tuesday.
Clarke's statement will be followed by a debate on his proposals which will be opened by opposition Labour Party leader Tony Blair.
- Questions to the Defence Secretary at 1430 GMT.
- Questions to the Prime Minister at 1515 GMT.
- Foreign Affairs Committee hears from junior Foreign Office minister Sir Nicholas Bonsor on the situation in the former Yugoslavia 1030 GMT.
